name: CoinGecko
tagline: Comprehensive cryptocurrency market data API for prices, market caps, and on-chain metrics
description: CoinGecko provides a widely used cryptocurrency data API covering coin prices, market capitalizations, trading volumes, historical charts, exchanges, NFTs, and on-chain/DeFi metrics. Developers use free and paid tiers to power portfolios, price trackers, and market analytics without scraping public pages.

auth.details: API key via x-cg-demo-api-key (Demo) or x-cg-pro-api-key (Pro) header, or query param; self-serve signup at CoinGecko

pricing.paid_plans: Analyst, Lite, Pro, Enterprise with higher rate limits and exclusive endpoints

rate_limits: Demo: 30 calls/min (and 10,000 calls/month). Paid tiers vary by plan on the pricing page; check current plan matrix for Analyst/Lite/Pro/Enterprise rates
use_cases: get current price of a cryptocurrency in USD
fetch market cap and 24h volume for top coins
retrieve historical price chart data for a coin
list supported exchanges and trading pairs
get coin metadata and contract addresses by platform
